[[Shorewatcher Reserve]]s are [[Istan]]i units called into [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan|Kamadan]] after a series of earthquakes. Their job is to help calm down citizens.

==Locations==
*[[Istan]]
**{{NPC location|Kamadan, Jewel of Istan}}

==Dialogue==
:''"A fissure opened on the Plains of Jarin after that last quake. Apparently it has some of the elders worried. Bendah is looking for adventurers to step inside to see what lies beneth."''

==Quotes==
:''"Move along citizens. Step aside. step {{sic}} aside."''
:''"[[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]]! Go to full alert! Keep the citizens safe."''
:''"The very walls of Kamadan shook during that last quake!"''
:''"You might want to put on a helmet!"''

==Trivia==
*This NPC was introduced on August 22, 2007 in preparation for the [[Guild Wars Eye of the North Sneak Peek Weekend]].
